findings.title: Preserve trace IDs in plugin request completion logs
findings.body: This removes the explicit `traceID` field previously added with `tracing.TraceIDFromContext`. The new contextual logger middleware adds endpoint, plugin, datasource, and user attributes, but does not add a trace ID, so completion logs for traced plugin requests can no longer be correlated with their traces.

findings.title: Keep contextual log calls observable in TestLogger
findings.body: `FromContext` returns a fresh `TestLogger` with separate counters and no shared recorder. `LoggerMiddleware` now logs through `m.logger.FromContext(ctx)`, so tests that inject a `TestLogger` and inspect the original instance will see no completion log and cannot reliably assert that it was emitted. Return a logger sharing the original capture state, or otherwise make derived logger calls observable.
